import pytest
from datetime import date
from module import LateFeeCalculator as L

def test_fees(monkeypatch):
    c = L(today=date(2024,1,1))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(0, date(2024,1,1)) == 0
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(-1, date(2024,1,1)) == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_weekday_days_between", lambda s,e: 10)
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,1)) == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_weekday_days_between", lambda s,e: 1)
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(100000, date(2024,1,1)) == 500
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_weekday_days_between", lambda s,e: 40)
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(1000000, date(2024,1,1)) == 20000
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_weekday_days_between", lambda s,e: 1000)
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(10000, date(2024,1,1)) == 2500

def test_weekdays():
    c = L()
    assert c._weekday_days_between(date(2024,1,1), date(2024,1,8)) == 5
    assert c._weekday_days_between(date(2024,1,8), date(2024,1,1)) == 0
